provenance_note: 132.0-B-3 prints no example frame; only the first OID octets of Annex D. Cases hand-derived from 132.0-B-3 §4.1 (figures 4-1 to 4-4, the Data Field Status of §4.1.2.7, the Secondary Header of §4.1.3, OID frames of §4.1.4.6 and Annex D, the FECF of §4.1.6), §5 Tables 5-1 to 5-3, and §6.3, with the readings of docs/standards/tm-frame.md (TM-001...TM-011 and the anomaly list) and the error kinds and field codes of docs/03-api-model.md §9 and §9.1. Inputs assembled bit by bit from the figure widths; expected values computed by an independent Python model of those clauses, written from the Blue Book after the Rust codec but not from its code, and sharing no code with it (the FECF by polynomial division, the OID data by the Annex D recurrence). The model is committed as test-vectors/models/tm_frame.py (TV-023); `python3 -I test-vectors/models/tm_frame.py --check test-vectors/tm/*.json` recomputes every expected value. One frame is worked by hand in docs/verification/derivations/tm-frame.md. Author of the model: an AI agent, Claude Opus 5.5, recorded as co-author of commit 5e1235e (2026-10-23); it wrote the model from 132.0-B-3 and docs/standards/tm-frame.md, and states that it did not write it from the code of the Rust codec (the history shows the codec already existed and records no briefing of the agent beyond that statement; TV-023). The cases tm-oid-005 to tm-oid-009 and tm-sec-dec-006, tm-sec-enc-003, tm-sec-val-003 were added on 2026-10-25 (M2 WP-8) by a second agent, Claude Sonnet 5.5, briefed to read only the Blue Book, docs/, and the vectors, never the implementation, and to extend this model. The cases tm-sec-enc-004 to tm-sec-enc-007 were added on 2026-10-25 by a blind Claude Sonnet 5.5 agent, after the review of #117. The cases tm-sec-dec-007 to tm-sec-dec-022 and tm-sec-val-004 to tm-sec-val-008 were added on 2026-10-25 by a blind Claude Sonnet 5.5 agent (OI-54: the decoder's rule for an Only Idle Data frame on a VC that uses SDLS), briefed to read only the Blue Book, docs/, and the vectors, never the implementation. This file covers 132.0-B-3 §6.3, Table 6-1.
